advancedArguments.name: fromDate
advancedArguments.description: Start date for the attendance period in format dd/mm/yyyy (e.g., '23/11/2019')

raw.description: Start date for the attendance period in format dd/mm/yyyy (e.g., '23/11/2019')

advancedArguments.name: toDate
advancedArguments.description: End date for the attendance period in format dd/mm/yyyy (e.g., '23/12/2025')

raw.description: End date for the attendance period in format dd/mm/yyyy (e.g., '23/12/2025')

advancedArguments.name: rosterCode
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster code to filter by specific roster (e.g., '000017'). Leave empty or omit to get all rosters. Default is empty string (all rosters).

raw.description: Optional roster code to filter by specific roster (e.g., '000017'). Leave empty or omit to get all rosters. Default is empty string (all rosters).

advancedArguments.name: filterMode
advancedArguments.description: Filter mode: '1' for specific employee (requires empNumber), '2' by roster (requires rosterCode), '3' for all records. Default is '3'.

raw.description: Filter mode: '1' for specific employee (requires empNumber), '2' by roster (requires rosterCode), '3' for all records. Default is '3'.

advancedArguments.name: isGroupByEmployee
advancedArguments.description: Whether to group results by employee. Default is false.

raw.description: Whether to group results by employee. Default is false.

advancedArguments.name: allInOut
advancedArguments.description: Include all in/out records. Default is true.

raw.description: Include all in/out records. Default is true.

advancedArguments.name: dataWithOT
advancedArguments.description: Include overtime data. Default is false.

raw.description: Include overtime data. Default is false.

advancedArguments.name: dataWithLate
advancedArguments.description: Include late records. Default is false.

raw.description: Include late records. Default is false.

advancedArguments.name: dataWithNoPay
advancedArguments.description: Include no-pay records. Default is false.

raw.description: Include no-pay records. Default is false.

advancedArguments.name: includeRejected
advancedArguments.description: Whether to also fetch rejected attendance records. Default is false.

raw.description: Whether to also fetch rejected attendance records. Default is false.

advancedArguments.name: employeeNumber
advancedArguments.description: Optional employee ID to filter by specific employee. Will be encrypted before sending to API. Leave empty to get all employees' attendance records.

raw.description: Optional employee ID to filter by specific employee. Will be encrypted before sending to API. Leave empty to get all employees' attendance records.
